title: High-speed train collision near Urda kills at least 68
description: Content note: mass-casualty incident. Two high-speed trains collided near Urda on the morning of October 28. Regional authorities reported at least 68 deaths while rescuers continued searching the wreckage. Services on the Madrid-southern Spain high-speed route were suspended, and the circumstances of the collision remained under investigation.

review.note: 68 is a provisional regional-government count reported on October 28, not a final toll. Injury totals differ by report and are not combined. AFP and RTE identify Wednesday October 28; an SBS report instead says October 27. The morning timing leaves the incident on October 28 in UTC.

title: Tharparkar ambulance fire kills eight, rescuers report
description: An ambulance caught fire at a health centre in Dano Dandal while staff were transferring a patient and handling an oxygen cylinder. The Express Tribune placed the incident at about 22:40 local time on October 28, or 17:40 UTC. Geo News later reported eight deaths after an injured person died during transfer to Mithi. The cause remained under investigation.

review.note: The explicit Wednesday 22:40 timestamp in The Express Tribune determines the UTC event date, not the October 29 publication date. Geo's closing text calls it Thursday's explosion, but its updated main report does not give an incident time. Its updated count of eight supersedes the initial seven after one further death; do not sum the reports. Cylinder involvement is reported, but the technical cause is not established.

promise: I would like to play the 2026 World Cup.
description: The cited desire to play in 2026 needs a dated source. Ronaldo would not become the oldest World Cup player merely by appearing at 41; FIFA records El Hadary's appearance at 45.
evidence: FIFA's age records contradict the claimed oldest-player outcome.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked pre-tournament coverage does not establish an actual appearance.

review.note: FIFA contradicts the oldest-player claim: Essam El Hadary played at 45 in 2018. Its pre-tournament article establishes neither Ronaldo's actual appearance nor the alleged July 5, 2024 statement. The aspirational wording must not be treated as a guarantee.

promise: Pursue a security crackdown on armed criminal groups rather than continue the prior peace-talks approach
description: De la Espriella outlined the policy in his August 7, 2026 inaugural address. The presidency announced termination of three dialogue processes on August 30; this is a policy action, not proof of eradicated crime.
evidence: Inaugural address pledges crackdown on armed groups and drug cartels
First-100-days focus on security expected, running to mid-November 2026

review.note: Inaugural hardline policy is supported; later government statement documents ending three dialogue processes. Analysts' first-100-days expectations cannot supply a presidential deadline or prove security outcomes.

promise: OpenAI reportedly projected $11.6 billion in revenue for 2025.
description: Reuters reported a company forecast, attributed to people familiar with it, of $11.6 billion in 2025 revenue.
evidence: The report concerns annual revenue, not an annualized run rate.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked report is a forecast, not audited 2025 results.

review.note: Reuters describes an anonymously sourced company forecast of $11.6 billion annual revenue, not an Altman quotation or annualized run rate. Its underlying report is dated September 27; the exact UTC publication day and date of the underlying forecast are not established. The claimed actual totals are not verified.
